## New

- **At a Glance shows the Pixel's Now Playing.** Songs your Pixel recognises playing nearby now show on At a Glance with the song and artist, like on the lock screen, for 10 minutes after they're heard. Tap one to open it in Now Playing. Turn it on or off under **Settings → Widgets → At a Glance → What to show → Now Playing: songs heard nearby**. It reads Now Playing's notification, so that notification needs to stay on in Now Playing's settings, and TheLauncher needs notification access.

## Fixed

- **The app icon stays put when you swipe home.** TheLauncher hid the icon while Android was meant to fly the app into it. On Pixels the app shrinks to the middle of the screen instead, so the icon just went missing for a moment. It now stays on screen the whole time.
- **The Google feed works through TheLauncher Feed.** The companion handed the Google app's connection straight to TheLauncher, and the Google app ignores TheLauncher. Now every call goes through the companion, as the Google app expects. TheLauncher Feed 1.1 comes inside this update: open **Settings → Integrations → Feed** and tap **Update TheLauncher Feed**.
